s.n: Car park frozen pea smash on toast
s.note: Smashed peas with mint, lemon and ricotta on garlic-rubbed grilled sourdough, with chilli flakes, parmesan and olive oil
s.how: Cook 500g frozen peas in boiling salted water for 3 minutes, drain and roughly smash with 2 tbsp olive oil, the zest and juice of 1 lemon, a handful of chopped mint and salt and pepper. Grill or toast 8 slices of sourdough, rub with a cut garlic clove and drizzle with oil. Spread with 200g ricotta, pile on the peas and finish with chilli flakes, shaved parmesan and more mint.

s.note: Crumbed fried risotto balls with parmesan and peas around a mozzarella centre, with warm tomato sauce
s.how: Soften 1 small chopped onion in 30g butter, stir in 300g arborio rice, then add 1 litre hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time over 20 minutes until thick and creamy. Stir in 50g parmesan and 1/2 cup peas, spread on a tray and chill for 2 hours. Roll into 16 balls around a cube of mozzarella, roll in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in breadcrumbs. Deep-fry at 180C in batches for 4 minutes until deep golden. Warm 400g passata with a little salt and basil and serve alongside.

m.n: Lorenzo's limo crew meatballs and spaghetti
m.note: Pork and beef meatballs with parmesan and parsley in a slow tomato, garlic and basil sauce, over spaghetti with more parmesan
m.how: Soak 60g fresh breadcrumbs in 60ml milk. Mix with 500g beef and pork mince, 1 egg, 1 grated garlic clove, 30g parmesan, chopped parsley and 1 tsp salt, then roll into 16 balls. Bake at 200C on an oiled tray for 15 minutes. Meanwhile soften 1 chopped onion and 3 sliced garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil, add 1.4kg passata, 1 tsp chilli flakes, the basil stalks and 1 tsp salt and simmer 20 minutes. Slip in the meatballs and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and serve with the meatballs, torn basil and more parmesan.

w.note: Crisp cannoli shells filled with sweetened vanilla and orange ricotta, ends dipped in pistachios and dark chocolate, dusted with icing sugar
w.how: Drain 500g firm ricotta in a sieve in the fridge for 1 hour. Beat with 80g icing sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 orange until smooth, then fold in 50g finely chopped dark chocolate. Spoon into a piping bag and chill. Just before serving, pipe into 12 cannoli shells from both ends, dip the ends in 40g chopped pistachios and dust with icing sugar.

d.note: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and fresh lime shaken hard and served straight up with an orange twist
d.how: Chill 4 coupe glasses. Shake 160ml vodka, 60ml orange liqueur, 240ml cranberry juice and the juice of 3 limes hard with ice. Strain into the glasses and twist a strip of orange peel over each so the oil sprays across the top.
